gloss_en: eyes (עֵינַיִם/Aram. עֵינִין) — the paired organ of sight, used by Rabbi Nachman as the symbolic seat of perception: guarded vision (tzitzit vs. straying after the eyes), judgment ('Ein Mishpat'), divine providence/watchfulness, wisdom, and livelihood ('the eyes of all look to You'); not the homographic ma'yan-sense of a water-spring standing alone
